title: cordia killipiana
intro: Cordia killipiana, commonly known as "Santa María", is a plant species in the Bignoniaceae family, native to Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has shown potential in providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Cordia killipiana include its ability to act as an antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral agent, as well as its potential to lower cholesterol levels and reduce blood sugar levels. The bioactive constituents of Cordia killipiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
